title: Citus: gracefully remove a Patroni member from a group
description: Runs `nexus scale-out remove citus citus-worker1-1`: stops nexus-patroni on a replica (PRIMARY-guarded — fail it over first). The group keeps quorum on its leader.

observe.what: gracefully left citus-worker1-1 from Patroni group citus-worker1; group keeps its leader; re-add via scale-out add

whatProves: CitusAdapter.ScaleOutRemoveAsync stops nexus-patroni on a replica member (refusing the current leader), leaving the group on its leader; reversible via scale-out add.
